This research composition was developed with OpenAI Codex assistance in the integer-mult-bounds repository. It preserves the inherited research and proof scope of its sources.

The copied PR568 constructor, omission auditor, recipes and explanatory materials come from Jeremy Kothe's `jeremykothe2/integer-mult-bounds`, commit `71c99ac935a33bb7b59a1b4a7af8725a939b0b90`, package `research/complex-multicold`. The source [LICENSE](upstream568/LICENSE) and [NOTICE.md](upstream568/NOTICE.md) are retained unchanged, including their WidthScreen/ReopenLoop and Claude Code assistance disclosures and eumemic/PR564 ancestry. The inspected PR567 recipes and construction note come from Jonathan Capalbo's `jon314159/integer-mult-bounds`, commit `7f452897d67282a76ada6df0162d34a751d5f3e6`, package `research/complex-doublecold`.

The global emitter, independent owner auditor, invoice, admission controls and assembly were adapted from the retained PR569 `research/larger-gain/global/width7/code` package. Its mathematical source was pinned at `f1db606a1416359229f944946667338305208064`; `1424da81263a5305b35e4cf74ef686c275f03f3f` supplies the unchanged missing evidence logs. The frame-promotion constructor and 32 recipes are also reused unchanged from PR569. The external source package is PR564 at `c18417b02b80594b2ca1c8c21185d28befafc935`. Its supplied licenses, notices and provenance continue to apply.

The literal 57-gate prefix was nominated by the collaborating joint-basis research task. Its source is `research/structural-gain/joint-basis/prefix-optimal-disjoint`; a frozen input and its hashes are retained in [prefix-input](prefix-input/SOURCE.json). New composition, owner-relabeling and reproduction scripts are included here. The new proof replays the composed word rather than assuming the nominator's optimality.

[SOURCE-PINS.json](SOURCE-PINS.json), [REPRODUCTION-PINS.json](REPRODUCTION-PINS.json) and [ADAPTATION.json](ADAPTATION.json) identify the copied and adapted inputs. [ADAPTATION.patch](ADAPTATION.patch) gives the exact global-code changes against PR569. No previously published package is modified by this directory.
